title: Orient: destroy the wrong model, act from the better one
summary: Build an orientation from reality, attack its assumptions, compare alternatives, then choose an action that tests the model. A planner drawing on John Boyd's orientation and destruction-and-creation ideas: a typed reality ledger, a reorientation trigger that can say keep acting, creative-destruction moves with required replacements, provisional adoption, frozen predictions and an append-only lineage of what was kept, destroyed and created. Ctrl/⌘ K search and commands, JSON import and export, three worked examples, and a narrated beamdswitch deck.
